title: Re: The Pillage People - Level 4
description: Re: The Pillage People - Level 4 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ticked Tomb Curator

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 20 Pillagers there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ticked Tomb Curator

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 20 Pillagers there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Despite your heroic efforts, more Pillagers have poured into the tomb and there is talk of turning the tomb into a full-blown discotheque. I'm pretty sure that the Pillagers are just doing this to push their own band, the Pillage People, in hopes that they can make it big. This can't happen Dungeon Runner! We, the united people of Townston, have left disco behind us for a reason and we can't let these pillagers bring it back.

Head down to the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist on Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and let those Pillagers feel the freak! Slay 20 of the Pillagers to keep them from opening the discotheque in the sacred and solemn tomb. I can't stress this enough, Dungeon Runner, we have left the polyester and bell-bottom pants in the past and that is where they should stay! Return to me, the Ticked Tomb Curator, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when you have finished this quest.

Turn-in:

Were you able to defeat the Pillagers? Well done! Would you like to do this again?

Objectives:

  • Slay Pillagers

Client level range: 83–86
